extDescription.message: Send downloads to the fluxdl download manager.

notifNotRunning.message: fluxdl isn't running (or isn't paired): the browser downloads the file.

notifKeptInBrowser.message: fluxdl not running — downloaded by the browser.

notifAppKept.message: fluxdl didn't take this link (failed before or refused): the browser downloads the file.

notifRateLimited.message: fluxdl received too many requests. Try again in a moment.

notifUnsupported.message: This link can't be sent to fluxdl (only http and https links).

statusNoAccess.message: No access to the app: open options

popupAutoCaptureHint.message: Big files and the extensions below go to fluxdl instead of the browser.

optTokenHint.message: Copy it from fluxdl → Settings, then paste it here.

optPortInvalid.message: Port must be a number between 1024 and 65535.

optGrantHint.message: The extension needs permission to talk to fluxdl on 127.0.0.1.

optCookiesHint.message: Only for sites that need you to be logged in to download. The site's cookies are sent to fluxdl on your computer only. Asks for access to cookies on all sites.

menuDownloadAll.message: Download all links on this page with fluxdl…

notifReloadPage.message: Reload the page, then try again (the extension isn't active on it yet).

popupFloatHint.message: Shows a “⬇ fluxdl” button when you hover a file link or a video.

optCaptureAllHint.message: Every http(s) browser download goes to fluxdl, whatever its size or extension (blob: and data: downloads always stay in the browser).

optAllowSitesHint.message: One site per line. A site also covers its subdomains. Downloads from these sites (or started from their pages) are captured regardless of size and extension.

optDenySitesHint.message: These sites always keep their downloads in the browser. Wins over the other rules.

optFloat.message: Show the fluxdl button on hover

optFloatHint.message: A small “⬇ fluxdl” button appears next to links to files (archives, installers, disk images, media, PDF…) or with a download attribute, and on videos and audio with a real address.

optFloatJsHint.message: Download buttons that start the file with a script (no link) don't show it: turn on automatic capture to catch those. Streamed videos (blob: addresses) can't be sent either.

optPickerHint.message: Right-click a page → “Download all links on this page with fluxdl…” to pick several files at once.

optCookieSitesHint.message: One site per line. Leave empty to send the cookies of every site.

pickEmpty.message: No links found on this page.

optPairHint.message: fluxdl then asks “Allow?”: click Allow in the app. No token to copy.

optManualHint.message: Or by hand: copy the token from fluxdl → Settings and paste it below.

pairBusy.message: Another request is waiting in fluxdl. Try again in a minute.

pairExpired.message: No answer from fluxdl (1 minute). Try again.

pairOld.message: This version of fluxdl can't pair automatically: update it, or paste the token.

notifVideoNotRunning.message: fluxdl is not running: start it, then click again.

notifNotVideoPage.message: Open the page of a video (not the home page or a list), then try again.

optVideoHint.message: On a video page, a “⬇ fluxdl” button appears in the corner of the player (and “Download this video with fluxdl” in the right-click menu): fluxdl gets the page link and lets you pick the quality. It follows the “Show the fluxdl button on hover” switch above.

optVideoCookies.message: Send my login cookies for this site

optVideoCookiesHint.message: Off by default. Needed only for subscriber-only or members-only videos and VODs. Only this site's cookies go to fluxdl on this PC (never to the Internet): kept in memory, written to a private temporary file for yt-dlp and deleted as soon as it finishes. Anyone with these cookies is logged in as you: turn this off on a shared PC.
